name: Spelunker
body:
You’re trained in the skills needed to explore and survive underground.

Prerequisite(s): favored terrain (underground) class feature.

Benefit(s): While in underground terrain, you gain a +2 bonus on Climb checks and on Acrobatics checks to cross narrow surfaces and uneven ground. Additionally, you get a +2 bonus to Perception checks against creatures that gain a species bonus to Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

Finally, you gain a +4 bonus on Fortitude saves against disease and poison effects caused by molds, fungus, and creatures of the ooze or plant type.

Character Options: The Ranger. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
